ExpXml: <Summary><Title>RNA-seq of tomato root tips treated or not with Leafamine®, a protein hydrolysate-based biostimulant, under optimal and heat stress conditions</Title><Platform instrument_model="DNBSEQ-G400">DNBSEQ</Platform><Statistics total_runs="1" total_spots="22188883" total_bases="6656664900" total_size="4780258631" load_done="true" cluster_name="public"/></Summary><Submitter acc="ERA36727254" center_name="European Bioinformatics Institute" contact_name="European Nucleotide Archive" lab_name="European Nucleotide Archive"/><Experiment acc="ERX16978954" ver="1" status="public" name="RNA-seq of tomato root tips treated or not with Leafamine®, a protein hydrolysate-based biostimulant, under optimal and heat stress conditions"/><Study acc="ERP201271" name="RNA-seq of tomato root tips treated or not with Leafamine?, a protein hydrolysate-based biostimulant, under optimal and heat stress conditions"/><Organism taxid="4081" ScientificName="Solanum lycopersicum"/><Sample acc="ERS30800173" name=""/><Instrument DNBSEQ="DNBSEQ-G400"/><Library_descriptor><LIBRARY_NAME>CT1R5D_p</LIBRARY_NAME><LIBRARY_STRATEGY>RNA-Seq</LIBRARY_STRATEGY><LIBRARY_SOURCE>TRANSCRIPTOMIC</LIBRARY_SOURCE><LIBRARY_SELECTION>PolyA</LIBRARY_SELECTION><LIBRARY_LAYOUT><PAIRED/></LIBRARY_LAYOUT><LIBRARY_CONSTRUCTION_PROTOCOL>Roots were sampled 5 days after their transfer onto 24x24 cm square culture boxes on medium with/without Leafamine treatment. Two-cm sections from the tip upwards were collected from the roots of 9 plants from 3 different experiments per sample and 3 samples per condition. Samples are immediately stored in liquid nitrogen after harvesting. Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum) cv. Microtom were used. Seeds were surface sterilized in a decontamination solution containing 50% (V/V) commercial bleach (9.6% active chlorine) and 0.05% (V/V) Tween80® (Sigma). The seeds were then rinsed three times in sterile water. For each experiment, seeds were evenly sown on ¼ MS medium including vitamins (Duchefa M0222) (Murashige T & Skoog, 1962) (pH=5.8) containing 7.5 g.L⁻¹ sucrose and 4 g.L⁻¹ agar (Kalys HP696) in 15 cm round Petri dishes (Greiner Bio-One 639102) (25 seeds per dish). The seeded plates were placed in a growth chamber (Hi-Point FH-740 Bionef) at 23°C/19°C day/night and a photoperiod of 16/8 h with a light intensity of 150 μmols–¹m-². For the Leafamine and heat stress assays, 8 to 15 tomato seedlings were grown in this medium for 7 days before being transferred onto 24x24 cm square culture boxes (ThermoFisher Scientific 40835 245x245x25). The medium used consisted of ¼ MS medium containing 7.5 g.L⁻¹ sucrose and 8 g.L⁻¹ agar, supplemented with Leafamine at concentrations of 0.2 g.L⁻¹. The same conditions described above were used for environmental NS conditions. After 1 day under these conditions, some plates were transferred to heat stress corresponding to 33°C during the day and 29°C at night. For total RNA extraction, 1mL TRIzol™ Reagent (Thermofisher Scientific) was added to samples, and then unfrozen at room temperature for a few seconds before grinding samples with metal beads and MP Fast-prep-24 (45' three times power 6). Then, RNA extraction was performed following the TRIzol in combination with RNeasy Kit (Qiagen) as following manufacturer's instructions. RNase-free DNase (Qiagen) treatment was performed on each sample.
